reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch confine the everlasting scope of Genesis 17 to God's grace-covenant with Abraham's spiritual seed, not to circumcision as a physical rite.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steven DiMattei catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steven DiMattei, Contradictions in the Bible (contradictionsinthebible.com), "#31. Is the covenant of circumcision an eternal covenant OR not?" (2013).

sides.snippet: My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
sides.verseText: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

sides.snippet: if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing
sides.verseText: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
